cultural.vision_reason: This is a traditional Palestinian village woman's thob with classic cross-stitch embroidery (qabbeh chest panel, sawa'id sleeves, mawaris furrows) in deep magenta and pink — a well-known and documented form of Palestinian dress.

physical.title: dress (thob)
physical.summary: Village woman’s dress (thob) with long narrow sleeves and a square neck opening made of white coloured cotton. The chest panel (qabbeh), yoke, top sleeves (sawa’id), cuffs, back and front furrows (mawaris), side panels (banayeq) and bottom back of skirt are embroidered with cross-stitch in shades of deep magenta and pink and embellished with vividly coloured cotton thread, especially on the chest panel. The dress is stitched together using a sewing machine, which has been used to embroider a wave, or snail like, motif alongside the furrows and along the hem in red cotton thread. The cuffs and neck opening are finished with interlacing cross stitch embroidery in differently coloured cotton thread.

dcDescription: Feestjurk (jellaya) afkomstig uit Beit Dajan in voormalig Palestina. De jurk werd tijdens bruiloften en andere feestelijke gelegenheden gedragen, samen met een zwarte linnen broek (sirwal) met borduurwerk op de pijpen. physical.title: dress
physical.summary: Village woman’s underdress made of cream coloured handwoven linen. The sleeves have red and blue selvedge stripes. The chest panel is lightly embroidered with cross stitch and satin in burgundy, red and green coloured floss silk. The collar is made of red and white Syrian silk ikat. The neck opening is trimmed with braided yellow coloured silk cord which has been used to create loops for the green coloured braided buttons for closure at the collar.

cultural.vision_reason: The image shows a traditional Palestinian village woman's thob (dress) with indigo-dyed cotton, pointed sleeves, and cross-stitch/embroidery details, matching well-documented Palestinian rural dress traditions.

physical.title: dress (thob)
physical.summary: Village woman’s dress (thob) with large pointed sleeves made of indigo dyed cotton. The chest panel is bordered with zigzag applique stitch in pink floss silk and sparsely embroidered with cross-stitch in pink and white floss silk. The top sleeve seams and side panle seams have been joined with knotted zigzag joining stitch in floss silk and re-embroidered with feather stitch in pink coloured cotton. The neck opening has also been re-patched with indigo dyed cotton and embroidered with feather stitch in yellow coloured cotton thread and buttonhole stitch in red coloured cotton. Two red wool cotton strings have been attached for closure. The underarms have been patched with machine woven blue coloured cotton.
